correctness.rationale: Eulerian arrow equations and directed square patterns are explicit, the two independent row-word and individual-edge DFS enumerations each obtain all 2970 states and 8768 undirected transitions. A separate explicit path of twelve moves and a face-height L1 lower bound of twelve prove sharpness. This is a finite exhaustive proof, not a claim about larger grids.

value.rationale: A canonical periodic six-vertex model and its elementary plaquette reversal yield a naturally motivated complete reconfiguration problem. The exact sector count, frozen boundary, two mobile diameters, sharp extremal pair and exceptional central centers distinguish connectivity from transformation cost and provide nontrivial reproducible benchmarks for local constrained dynamics. The computation is a complete classification of a mathematical invariant, not an arbitrary small sample.
